themes.title: Fuel‑Price Crisis Spurs Right‑Wing Policy Push
themes.blurb: Right‑wing actors in the United States and Norway are foregrounding fuel scarcity and high diesel prices, each calling for dramatic measures – the U.S. president urging Europe to release diesel reserves while Norwegian parties demand immediate fuel‑tax cuts.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump announced plans to ask Europe to release diesel reserves to curb record‑high fuel prices.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: FrP, together with Sp and KrF, launched a joint demand for fuel‑tax reductions for the rest of the year.

themes.title: Legal Pushback Against Trump‑Era Executive Actions
themes.blurb: Courts and lawmakers across the Atlantic are challenging the Trump administration’s expansive use of power, from loyalty‑test hiring rules to the redirection of foreign‑aid funds, echoing broader right‑wing concerns about unchecked authority.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Multiple rulings and lawsuits question the legality of the administration’s loyalty questionnaire, FMF fund reprogramming, and immigration detention policies.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: SD’s criticism of governmental overreach in regional governance reflects a parallel narrative of resisting centralized authority.

themes.title: Right‑Wing Parties Gaining Regional Power
themes.blurb: Both Sweden’s Sweden Democrats and Norway’s Progress Party are moving into influential regional roles, forming or demanding coalitions that shift local governance toward nationalist agendas.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: SD entered the executive board of Region Skåne and refused to support a new regional coalition without concessions.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: FrP teamed with Sp and KrF to press for fuel‑tax cuts and challenge the ruling party in Parliament.
